{"metadata":{"description":"修复dsh上opencode go模型列表问题","id":"gh:1373862854","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-opencode-go-model-list","slug":"xiaobbl/dsh-opencode-go-model-list","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"修复dsh上opencode go模型列表问题"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"[](README.md) [](README.zh.md)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-opencode-go-model-list"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Keeps the harness's **own** `opencode-go` provider route on the model list opencode Go actually serv"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"es — no second provider, no `settings.yaml` edits, no credential handling, and no shipped model over"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"second provider, no `settings.yaml` edits, no credential handling, and no shipped model overwritten."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Before: the `opencode-go` route lists 27 models (pi-ai's shipped snapshot)
- After: the same route"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" lists 38 — adding `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `kimi-k2.5`, `grok-4.5`, `glm-5`, `qwen3.5-plus`, `mimo-v2"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"-pro/omni`, `minimax-m2.5`, `deepseek-flash`, `hy3-preview`, `union-alpha`"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The problem it closes"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"When opencode ships a model the harness snapshot predates (for example `deepseek-v4.1-flash`), the r"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"oute cannot serve it, and adding it by configuration fails:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Every configuration path has a cost — see discussion #6464:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Path | Cost |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `providers.opencode-go.models` | **replaces** the route's whole catalog (all 27 shipped models), a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"nd every entry must restate `api`/`baseURL` |
| `modelOverrides` | only reshapes ids the catalog alr"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"eady describes; a new id is refused |
| a custom route | is not the built-in `opencode-go`, so balan"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ce/cost/session plugins no longer recognize it |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"This plugin takes the third path: it contributes **into the catalog itself**, so a new model becomes"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" the third path: it contributes **into the catalog itself**, so a new model becomes a shipped model."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **Catalog contribution** — missing models are added to pi-ai's `opencode-go` catalog object (`MOD"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ELS['opencode-go']`), which is exactly what `dsh-llm-pi-ai` reads while resolving the route (`getBui"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ltinModels('opencode-go')`). Settings surfaces, model validation, and request resolution therefore t"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"reat them as built-ins.
2. **Collection patch** — the pi-ai model collection's `getModels` is wrappe"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"d so a route that already resolved still sees entries that arrive later. A background refresh lands "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"in the model picker and the request path **without a restart**.
3. **Cache** — a successful fetch is"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" written to `$DSH_HOME/cache/opencode-go-model-list/catalog.json`, adopted synchronously on the next"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" boot, and refreshed in the background. Offline hosts keep the last good list."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Sources and inference rules"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Source | Role |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models` | which models the plan **serves** (public, no auth; 38"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" at the time of writing) |
| `GET https://models.dev/api.json`, `opencode-go` slice | context/output"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" limits, modalities, cost, reasoning options, `family` (37 records) |
| the shipped catalog | `api`,"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" `baseUrl`, `compat` (vendor wire dialect), thinking-level spellings |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Each field is resolved on its own evidence:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **protocol**: same-`family` shipped model → the SDK the provider itself declares (`provider.npm`) "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"→ the vendor's majority protocol → the route's majority protocol → `defaultApi`
- **compat**: the fi"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"elds *every* shipped model of that protocol agrees on (route-level facts such as `supportsStore:fals"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"e`), extended by a same-family model's own dialect (deepseek's `thinkingFormat: deepseek`) — never g"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"uessed across vendors
- **thinking levels**: the upstream's declared efforts, spelled the way a same"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"-family model spells them; with no same-family model, undeclared levels are pinned explicitly
- **un"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"described models** (`hy3-preview`): cloned from the nearest sibling by id prefix, named from the id"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Fidelity regression against the shipped catalog itself (`test/fidelity.test.mjs`, each entry rebuilt"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" with the model removed from the shipped set): `reasoning`/`input`/`contextWindow`/`maxTokens` match"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" 27/27, `api` 26/27, `name` 26/27, `cost` 22/27, `compat`/`thinkingLevelMap` 21/27. The gaps are cur"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ated facts no listing endpoint discloses (price revisions, vendor dialects)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Option 1: the standard `dsh plugin` command"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory and then reconciles `dsh.pr"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ofile.bundles` **against installed state**: any dependency whose package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" joins the profile layer stack. This package declares it, so one command covers dependency, `node_mo"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"dules`, and bundle registration. Verified in an isolated home: both `link:` and `file:` registered t"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"he bundle and booted to 38 models. pnpm must be on PATH (11.17.0 here)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- `link:`: the profile's `node_modules` points at this checkout — edits apply immediately, but the d"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"irectory must stay put.
- `file:`: pnpm packs a copy honoring `files`, self-contained; re-run `add` "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"to update.
- If a run ever leaves the bundle unregistered (seen once in the first trial), `dsh plugi"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"n --profile web install` re-registers it from installed state."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Option 2: `install.ps1` (no pnpm needed)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The script does exactly two things: copies the package to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"/dsh-opencode-go-model-list`, and appends the package name to that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"It never writes into the dsh installation, `settings.yaml`, or the credential store. Verified that `"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"pnpm install` / `pnpm add` do not prune such a copy (it sits outside pnpm's dependency graph, which "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"is also why `update` will not upgrade it)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"After a restart, expect:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Uninstall with `uninstall.ps1` (add `-RemoveCache` to drop the cache). Nothing on disk in the instal"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"lation was ever modified, so removal restores the previous list exactly."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Verify without touching your profile"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Built-in route only**: the plugin never calls `llm.registerAdapter` and registers no provider. `"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"opencode-go` stays the catalog provider `dsh-llm-pi-ai` reuses — same API implementations, same ambi"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"ent credential discovery, same `apiKeyEnv`.
- **dsh-opencode-session-id**: it injects `x-opencode-se"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ssion` and friends by route name plus URL host (`opencode.ai`). Contributed models use the same rout"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"e and base URL, so session headers keep flowing.
- **dsh-cost-meter**: provider and model naming are"},{"id":"p36s6","text":" unchanged, and every contributed entry carries `cost` (from models.dev). Whether its own price tabl"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"e covers a new model is that plugin's data question.
- **Reversible**: shipped entries are never ove"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"rwritten unless `updateExisting: true`; unmounting withdraws exactly the contributed ids and restore"},{"id":"p36s9","text":"s the original collection method."}],"truncated":true}
